test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

I__ long from travel__ outside the country, dreaming of adventures among the towering Alps and basking in the turquoise waters of the Caribbean.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. long to travel .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"long to travel"** is correct in the given context because the verb "long" is typically followed by an infinit
